entities.summary: Robert Hranj is a Croatian Admiral, who served as Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Croatia. He was appointed to that position on 1 March 2020 after Zoran Milanović became the new President of Croatia. He was replaced in that position by Colonel general Tihomir Kundid on 8 March 2024.
